system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

The Senju clan has a unique talent for manifesting Wood Release due to their close affinity to both Earth and Water Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Wood Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Earth or Water release keywords, you can change the damage type to Earth or cold respectively.

Additionally, once per turn, as a Bonus action, by selecting one creature you can see within 30 feet of you that are Grappled or Restrained as a result of a Senju Hijutsu or has ranks of Drained. You force the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw, being pulled 20 feet closer or pushed 20 feet further away from you on a failed save.
